name: SBH
recent: 近期公告主要是集团董事经理 Tan Boo Nam 在闭门期内的持股变动申报，他在 11 月多次增持公司股份。同期没有其他合约、企业活动或监管事件公布。
notable: 集团董事经理 Tan Boo Nam 在闭门期内多次增持公司股份，包括 11 月 5 日 115,000 股、11 月 6 日 300,000 股、11 月 10 日 1,400,000 股及 11 月 12 日 300,000 股。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收为 42,944,000 令吉，环比增长 9.5%，同比减少 3.1%；净利为 508,000 令吉，净利率 1.2%，较上一季度的 -6.3% 转正，净利同比增加 7.6%。

recent_en: Recent announcements mainly involve dealings by Group Managing Director Tan Boo Nam during the closed period, with multiple acquisitions of shares in November. No other contracts, corporate exercises or regulatory events were announced in the same period.
notable_en: Group Managing Director Tan Boo Nam acquired shares multiple times during the closed period, including 115,000 shares on 5 Nov, 300,000 on 6 Nov, 1,400,000 on 10 Nov and 300,000 on 12 Nov.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 42,944,000, up 9.5% QoQ but down 3.1% YoY; net income was MYR 508,000 with a net margin of 1.2%, turning positive from -6.3% in the prior quarter, while net income rose 7.6% YoY.
